mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_attempt ( payment_attempt_id, payment_intent_id, attempt_no, source_submission_id, payment_method_code, capture_mode, payment_instrument_token_id, channel_id, channel_account_id, mid_id, attempt_status, active_action_id, authorized_amount, captured_amount, version, create_time, update_time ) SELECT #{paymentAttemptId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{paymentIntentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{attemptNo,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sourceSubmissionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{paymentMethodCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{captureMode,javaType=com.paytech.payment.execution.core.enums.CaptureMode,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.CodeEnumTypeHandler,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{paymentInstrumentTokenId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{channelId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{channelAccountId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{midId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{attemptStatus,javaType=com.paytech.payment.execution.core.enums.AttemptStatus,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.CodeEnumTypeHandler,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{activeActionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{authorizedAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{capturedAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{version,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{createTime,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateTime,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} FROM t_payment_instrument_token token JOIN t_payment_intent intent ON intent.payment_intent_id = token.payment_intent_id WHERE token.payment_instrument_token_id = #{paymentInstrumentTokenId} AND token.payment_intent_id = #{paymentIntentId} AND token.revoked_at IS NULL AND token.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND intent.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
